commits.message:
Text strips the bidi controls that open a direction state (0.24.1) (#482)

* Text strips the bidi controls that open a direction state, so content cannot reverse the rest of its line (0.24.1)

U+202A-U+202E (embeddings, overrides) and U+2066-U+2069 (isolates) join the C0 set in stripControlChars, the one sanitizer every Text passes. An unclosed U+202E in content reversed whatever the terminal drew after it on the line; cc-candybar measured one in a lit ticket description reaching the bar (brandon-unfiled-3248.qum). The marks (LRM, RLM, ALM) open no state and pass.

* Text strips the C1 controls and the deprecated shaping switches too, and pad and truncate sanitize what they add

The high review: C1 (U+009B is CSI) passed Text while TextInput refused it; pad/padLeft/padRight's char and truncate's marker reached the text unsanitized; PDF and PDI close a state rather than open one; U+206A-U+206F hold state as the bidi controls do. The test derives the bidi set from \p{Bidi_Control}. NEL in a code span is now stripped as the C1 control it is.

Backwards, a frame whose cells move answers t; update re-arms a paused Live (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Medium-pass fixes: an animation view's moving cells no longer freeze an App
run backwards until the view's own lastChange; a view handed over by
update() after a pause is drawn by the auto-refresh; a renderable reading
its own clock belongs off the timeline, said in view.ts and the docs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

A renderable view is off the timeline; the default timeline starts when the host is made (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Review fixes: a renderable's cell stamps are read on the host's clock and
pausing holds none of it; a paused timeline stops an App's animate() ticking
as it stops a Live; systemClock().at waits out a hold longer than a timer
holds instead of throwing; docs say a Live draws at its rate throughout and
an App's rate does not cap a held frame's wake; view is in CLAUDE.md's tiers.
